pages.text: The strongest fairy in Gensokyo (self-proclaimed). $(br2)Feeding her works exactly as it does for a plain fairy: four Packed Ice for a cookie, a whole Fairy Ice Crystal for a cake.

pages.title: Fairy Ice Crystal
pages.text: Throw one and it bursts where it lands. Whatever the burst reaches is hurt and left frozen.$(br2)Within 6-block radius:$(br2)$(li)Candles and campfires are put out.$(li)Water becomes ice, lava becomes obsidian, and lava that is not a source becomes cobblestone.

pages.title: Frozen Frogs
pages.text: Frogs frozen by a Fairy Ice Crystal. Throw one and it lands back as a frog.
